key.name: position
key.summary: Screen edge the panel sits on

key.name: panel-height
key.summary: Panel thickness in pixels (height, or width for a left/right panel)

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Largest taskbar icon size in pixels (icons otherwise follow the panel height)

key.name: show-favorites
key.summary: Show pinned (favorite) apps in the taskbar

key.name: show-apps-button
key.summary: Show the app grid button at the start of the taskbar

key.name: group-windows
key.summary: One taskbar button per app; off: one button per window

key.name: show-labels
key.summary: Show the window title (or app name) next to each taskbar icon; top or bottom panel only

key.name: clock-style
key.description: gnome: the stock one-line clock. windows: Windows 11 style, time over date, right-aligned. A left/right panel always shows time over a short date.

key.name: show-power-icon
key.summary: Show the power (battery) icon in Quick Settings

key.name: window-previews
key.summary: Show window previews when hovering a taskbar button

key.name: preview-delay
key.summary: Hover time in milliseconds before a window preview opens

key.name: preview-size
key.summary: Width of a 16:9 window's preview thumbnail in pixels; thumbnails follow their window's shape

key.name: panel-layout
key.summary: Which modules sit in the left, center and right section of the panel
key.description: Keys are left, center and right; values are ordered module ids (arcmenu, weather, activities, taskbar, clock, indicators, quickSettings). Modules that appear in no section are hidden.
